text:
laura_ae: Quick sync — Acme is asking for a 4-week trial to validate search-augmentation + summarization. Need: success criteria, SE staffing plan, pricing for trial vs dedicated, and security checklist by EOD tomorrow. @dan_se can you confirm resourcing? @riley_security any obvious blockers on the questionnaire? cc @mike_acme

dan_se: I can cover SE support: roughly 0.5 FTE week 1 (onboarding), 0.75 FTE weeks 2–3 (prompt tuning + evals), 0.25 FTE week 4 (handoff/docs). Will need one backend eng (ari_eng) for dataset access/tokenization edge cases. ETA to deliver eval harness: ~5 business days.

ari_eng: I can carve out ~3 days in week 1 for infra + ingestion. I need S3 creds + a sample (50k rows). Also confirm model variant — they asked about `redwood-medium-q8` tradeoffs vs `redwood-small-q4` for cost.

riley_security: Security checklist: we'll need completed security questionnaire, signed DPA, and IP addendum. Customer also asked about logs retention and KMS/HSM options. I'll start the questionnaire now; target 48h turnaround if nothing major pops up.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: cluster capacity check — small dedicated canary (2 GPUs) is available this week; full 8-GPU trial window open 2026-04-05 to 2026-04-26 if they commit.

laura_ae: Finance note: trial usage billed at an eval rate (50% off hosted list). If they convert to Dedicated, commit tiers apply — I'll send exact numbers shortly.

dan_se: Proposed success criteria (suggested): 1) p95 latency < 400ms on typical queries, 2) generation quality: Rouge-L >= 0.62 on our prompt eval set, 3) cost <= $1.20 per 1k tokens with batching + q8 config, 4) zero P1 incidents during trial window. Feedback?

mike_acme: Latency target seems fine. For quality, can you run a small eval first? we'll upload 150 annotated examples. Also can SE join our weekly ops review Tue 10am PT?

ari_eng: Please upload eval CSV to s3://redwood-acme-poc/input_eval.csv and grant role `redwood-ci-role` read. I'll run a baseline and share initial metrics.

riley_security: :thumbsup: I'll flag any high-risk items in the questionnaire. One potential blocker: customer requested HSM-backed keys for model logs — we can support via partner KMS but that may add ~2–3 weeks to timeline.

laura_ae: Next steps: (1) @mike_acme upload eval CSV by EOD Thu, (2) @dan_se + @ari_eng deliver baseline harness + initial run by next Wed (ETA 1867809000), (3) @riley_security return questionnaire in 48h, (4) I'll share pricing/commit doc. @dan_se can you confirm SE can join Tue ops review?

dan_se: Confirmed — calendar hold set. I'll also prepare a short runbook for common failure modes and a 2-config canary vs q8 A/B test.

mike_acme: Uploading now, will ping when done. Thanks for the clear plan.

laura_ae: :raised_hands: Great — I'll follow up with a one-pager and action items. Flag any blockers in this thread and we'll escalate.
